desc:
⚔️ Survive 50 waves of samurai armies with up to 4 friends! ⚔️

🏯 HOW TO PLAY
🗡️ Pick a class and fight through huge waves of enemies!
👹 Foot soldiers, archers, sumo wrestlers, bandits and mighty BOSSES!
🧱 Build fences, set traps and place gear to hold the line!
⬆️ Upgrade your weapons mid-battle to hit even harder!
🤝 Revive fallen allies. If everyone falls, it's GAME OVER!

🔥 CLASSES
⚔️ Samurai: balanced sword fighter (FREE!)
💊 Medic: heal your team with recovery towers
🪓 Axe Squad: bear traps and catapults
🔱 Spear Squad: long reach and spike floors

🏆 REWARDS
💰 Clear all 30 waves to earn credits!
📅 7-day login rewards, up to 5000 credits!
📜 Daily and weekly quests!
🏅 Leaderboards: climb to the top!

🎁 BONUSES
👥 Join the group → 1000 CREDITS FREE!
📨 Invite a friend → you BOTH get 1000 CREDITS!

👍 Like and Favorite the game!
